\begin{convention} \end{convention}[compact and proper metric spaces]

Source: petersen:page-0409 We restrict to compact or proper metric spaces: spaces whose distance function is proper, i.e. all closed balls are compact. Proper metric spaces are automatically separable, complete, and locally compact. \end{convention}
